description: Open a named session on a remote host. Use type="interactive" for stateful shell (CWD/env persists between commands) or type="background" for long-running processes.

name.description: Session name (alphanumeric, dash, underscore, max 64 chars)

ttlMs.description: Idle timeout for THIS session in ms (the profile default applies when omitted). May shorten the profile timeout; may lengthen it only up to sessionBackgroundMaxMs for a background session, or not at all for an interactive one

name: open-session
